title: ふたりの進む、その先"へ"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and I happen to overhear a conversation as we arrive at the training course.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey! Did you hear what Tama did?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You mean when she came from the back and whizzed past fifteen people all at once? Yeah, I heard!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Isn't that awesome? Especially when you consider how tiny she is!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Right? I used to think she was just cute, but she's actually pretty cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I feel like she looked more serious than usual though. It kinda freaked me out…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm going for a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap starts to run, despite barely having done her warm-ups. It seems like her head is somewhere else though, seeing as she dashes off in the wrong direction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I call out to her, but she doesn't come back. Panicked, I set off in pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flustered, I search all over for her. I eventually track her down, but it appears someone else has beaten me to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see… So that's why things have soured between you and Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You had me worried, just standin' there in front of that tree stump like that…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You are such a dummy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I just don't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like she's asking Inari One and Super Creek for some advice, so I decide to stand back and watch from afar.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You and Tamtam are really good friends. I understand why you're confused.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But you guys can't carry on like this! If she's truly your friend, ya need to spill your guts and talk things through!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: S-spill my guts?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just to be clear, that's just an expression! What I really mean is ya have to be open and honest about how you feel!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I know that. I'm just not confident I'd be able to get my point across properly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And that's okay. You don't need to say anything special.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You just need to be upfront about how it made you feel being called her rival.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Be honest with Tamtam about your true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My true feelings? I think I remember Tama telling me something like that before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …All right! I'm gonna go speak with her!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You've got this! She's by the river!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Oguri! ♪ I want you to be able to bring your A game the next time I run against you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Oguri! The river's the other way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm going to have to chase after her again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, time for some joggin'!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-Oguri?! And…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, Your trainer's huffin' and puffin' like a hound dog.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Oguri Cap has no sense of direction whatsoever, I ended up having to guide her the whole way here. Thankfully, though, we were able to track Tamamo Cross down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Listen, Tama. I'm… I'm…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you're my friend!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that you were the first person who came and spoke to me in the beginning. And I'm really glad that we get to share a room!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And… I'm glad you called me your rival!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's just… I couldn't wrap my head around how I could be friends with someone and compete against them at the same time. And because of that, I hurt you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I'm okay now. I think I've figured it out. You're my friend, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And you're my rival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Up till now, I never could've even imagined having someone as special as you in my life…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: What's that commotion over there? Is someone… declaring their love?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: No way! In a place like this? Talk about brave!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, Oguri! I got ya. Chill out for a sec, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, no more waiting! I want to tell you exactly how I feel!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it is a confession! First time I've seen one with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama! The truth is, I…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: WAIT! Seriously! Put a sock in it for a sec! Zip it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …I get how ya feel. I mean, ya haven't really left me with much choice!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Really?! Does that mean you're not mad at me anymore?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Naw, I'm still mad. You still gotta prove to me that ya mean what you're sayin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya know why I stayed here instead of aimin' for the Dream Trophy and rakin' in the big bucks?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's 'cause I don't wanna move up until I prove to everyone that I'm the strongest in our generation!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I asked ya this before, didn't I? How are you gonna show everyone how great you are?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck? Cat got your tongue? Bein' a Goody Two-shoes isn't gonna get ya the credit that ya deserve!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I'm gonna work my way up by winning. There's no other way to do it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's right. There's only one thing I want from ya—a race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The only way I'll know whether you're serious or not is when we go head-to-head.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now, listen up. I'm runnin' in the Tenno Sho in both spring and autumn!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Held every spring and autumn, the Tenno Sho is a legendary race with a long history and is one of the most important G1 races out there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's up to you to decide what ya wanna do. Talk it over with yer trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still pantin', huh?! How long were ya runnin' for? Poor thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Anyway, ya get my drift. I'll be waitin' for ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a quiet fire burning in Oguri Cap's eyes as she watches Tamamo Cross walk away.
